3	-- Rollback: DROP VIEW IF EXISTS client_health_summary;
4	--           DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_client_notes_health_aggregate;
5	-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

7	-- Partial composite index on client_notes for view performance.
8	-- Covers the WHERE + GROUP BY columns the view uses.
9	CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_client_notes_health_aggregate
10	  ON client_notes (client_id, studio_id, category, is_pinned)
11	  WHERE category IN ('allergies', 'medical', 'skin', 'emergency_contact');
12	
13	-- View: per-client health aggregate
14	-- security_invoker = true is CRITICAL: view executes with the calling user's
15	-- permissions, not the view owner's. This means the existing client_notes RLS
16	-- policies (studio-scoped) are respected. Without it, the view would run as
17	-- the definer and bypass RLS — exposing all studios' health data to any
18	-- authenticated user who can read the view.
19	CREATE VIEW client_health_summary
20	WITH (security_invoker = true)
21	AS
22	SELECT
23	  cn.client_id,
24	  cn.studio_id,
25	  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cn.category = 'allergies')::int            AS allergy_count,
26	  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cn.category = 'medical')::int              AS medical_count,
27	  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cn.category = 'skin')::int                 AS skin_count,
28	  COUNT(*) FILTER (
29	    WHERE cn.is_pinned = true
30	      AND cn.category IN ('allergies', 'medical', 'skin', 'emergency_contact')
31	  )::int                                                             AS critical_pinned_count,
32	  ARRAY(
33	    SELECT DISTINCT cn2.category
34	    FROM   client_notes cn2
35	    WHERE  cn2.client_id = cn.client_id
36	      AND  cn2.studio_id = cn.studio_id
37	      AND  cn2.category  IN ('allergies', 'medical', 'skin')
38	      AND  cn2.is_pinned = true
39	    ORDER BY cn2.category
40	  )                                                                  AS alert_categories,
41	  MAX(cn.updated_at) FILTER (
42	    WHERE cn.category IN ('allergies', 'medical')
43	  )                                                                  AS last_medical_update
44	FROM client_notes cn
45	GROUP BY cn.client_id, cn.studio_id;
46	
47	GRANT SELECT ON client_health_summary TO authenticated;
48	
49	COMMENT ON VIEW client_health_summary IS 'S18 — Aggregates client_notes for allergy/medical alerts across booking surfaces. critical_pinned_count drives HealthAlertBadge visibility.';
